latestVersion.changelog:
Manager Video skill — initial release.

- Edit and export manager or team videos for internal distribution. Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB.
- Provides cloud-based video processing (1–2 minutes per task) with 1080p MP4 output.
- Handles uploads, editing, trimming, chapter markers, highlight reels, and exports via cloud API.
- Automatically manages user sessions and authentication (with support for anonymous users and token refresh).
- Built-in error handling for token, file, credit, and plan issues; guided user feedback on next steps.
- Includes quick-start tips and common workflows for managers and team leads.
